observable_outcome: A Runner reports the version it is actually running through one additive optional object on the heartbeat it already sends -- binary version, binary digest, and the closed canonical schema interval [schema_min, schema_max] -- and GET /v1/runners plus a Runners block in the owner console report, per Runner: whether a report exists at all, whether the newest one is stale, the reported coordinates when and only when a report exists, and the intersection of every enumerated Runner's interval with an explicit unknown whenever any Runner has not reported. The report is never consulted by any authentication or authorization path, a partial report is refused, and a Runner-supplied timestamp cannot enter the record because the request carries no timestamp field.
acceptance_criteria: A1. Scope boundary, written before any code. The evidence opens with a table with one row per coordinate group in docs/operations/self-update.md section 5.1 (binary; canonical schema; contract including runner_api range; bundle; provenance) stating for each: whether a running binary carries the value today with the file and line that proves it, whether this task reports it, and who owns the remainder. The rows for contract, bundle and provenance must say plainly that no code in the repository produces those values and name V2-034 (manifest fields) and V2-074 (compatibility decision) as owners. A further row must state that this task introduces no canonical schema counter and no advance operation, and that currentSchema exists only as a parameter at internal/update/update.go:41 and :71. Nothing in the evidence may claim or imply that this task satisfies any part of the section 6 invariant beyond supplying its input, and nothing may claim any release gate.

A2. Baseline, measured before changing anything. Record top-level test names and counts and that all pass for internal/application (49 top-level tests at the starting commit), internal/api (20), internal/store/memory (4) and internal/store/firestore (9 across store_test.go and quota_integration_test.go). Record the measured absence this task removes: internal/api/api.go:84 emits a static schema_version "v1"; the only other version-shaped fields in internal/api are optimistic-concurrency Expected*Version; internal/domain declares type RunnerID string at model.go:16 and no Runner aggregate; internal/application/repository.go:548 records that RunnerObservationRepository is keyed by a single runner id with no enumeration port; cmd/runner/main.go:13 carries const version and cmd/runner/main.go:28-30 refuses to run without --fake because no external control-plane wiring is enabled; a search for net/http over internal/runner returns nothing. Every pre-existing test must still pass at the end under its existing name with its existing assertions unchanged, and before/after top-level counts per touched package must be reported.

A3. Report shape, closed and minimal. internal/application gains RunnerVersionReport with exactly four reported scalar fields (version, binary_sha256, schema_min, schema_max) plus a reported_at set from the transaction's authority time. Assert by AST field-name scan over the new request DTO, the port type, the stored record and the read model that there is no message, detail, output, text, hostname, host, ip, path, root, env or timestamp field on any of them, and that none of them matches the credential deny list internal/domain/source_guard_test.go declares (copy the deny list by value; do not import internal/domain's test). Verify the matcher against a known-positive and a known-negative before trusting it.

A4. Validation is shape only and rejects a partial object. Assert with table tests driven through the API: version accepted only when it matches the semver shape internal/update/update.go:23 pins, with at least four accepted and six rejected literals including a bare major.minor, a leading v, an uppercase prerelease and an empty string; binary_sha256 accepted only at exactly 64 lowercase hex characters, rejected at 63, 65, uppercase and non-hex; schema_min rejected below 1; schema_max rejected below schema_min; both rejected above the declared ceiling. Assert that an object carrying any strict non-empty subset of the four fields is 400 and stores nothing -- in particular that schema_max without schema_min is refused rather than stored as an interval starting at zero. Assert that omitting runner_version entirely is 200 and stores nothing, and that every existing heartbeat assertion still passes unchanged.

A5. The Runner clock cannot enter the record. Assert that the request object has no timestamp field at all (part of the A3 scan) and that the stored reported_at equals the transaction authority time used by the same heartbeat's recorded event -- byte-identical, asserted by comparing the stored value with the event's At rather than by re-reading the clock. Assert the value is stable across a transaction retry by driving the Firestore adapter's retry path, or record that check as skipped with its reason if the retry path cannot be driven; a skip is never counted as a pass.

A6. Three states, no default interval, explicit unknown. Assert directly, with an injected clock and no sleep: (a) a Runner with no report reports report_state not-reported, carries no version, no binary digest and no interval at all in the marshalled JSON, and never reports an interval of [0,0] or any other synthesized value; (b) one valid report reports report_state reported with the four coordinates echoed exactly; (c) a report older than the declared staleness window reports report_state stale with the previously reported coordinates preserved and marked stale rather than silently refreshed or dropped; (d) the intersection view reports intersection_state unknown whenever any enumerated Runner is not in state reported, including the case where exactly one of two Runners has reported; (e) with two Runners reporting overlapping intervals the state is non-empty and the reported endpoints are the max of the minima and the min of the maxima; (f) with two Runners reporting disjoint intervals the state is empty; (g) a table test fails if an enum constant is added without a case or a case without a constant, for report_state and intersection_state both; (h) no field name and no enum value in the marshalled view spells compatible, ok, healthy or valid without unknown being a sibling value of the same enum -- asserted by walking the marshalled JSON keys and enum values.

A7. The report is never authority over reads. Assert both halves. Mechanical: an AST scan asserting that internal/api/auth.go and application's runnerCaller/callerActor admission path reference neither the report type nor the new port, failing outright on a zero-file scan and verified first against a known-positive fixture. Behavioural: a Runner posts a report whose interval is deliberately absurd (schema_min and schema_max both at the declared ceiling), then succeeds unchanged, with identical status codes and identical response bodies to a Runner that reported nothing, at every runner-facing operation -- claims:acquire, permits:check, executions:start, executions/result, heartbeat and checkpoints. Record the status code of each of the six before and after.

A8. Enumeration is bounded and does not grow with Requirement count. RunnerVersionReports is bounded by a declared constant MaxRunnerVersionReports; assert the bound by storing more reports than it and checking the returned count and the fixed order. Assert that one GET /v1/runners performs no write and enqueues no outbox record. For the Firestore adapter record the measured read count for one GET /v1/runners against a fixture at the bound and assert it is bounded by a constant that does not vary with the number of Requirements in the store, by running the same measurement with the Requirement count at two different values and recording both.

A9. Both store adapters, one behavioural table. internal/store/memory and internal/store/firestore both implement the new port, and the same test table runs against both so the memory store cannot pass behaviour the Firestore store does not implement. Assert last-writer-wins per RunnerID, assert a rolled-back transaction leaks no report into committed state in both adapters, and assert the report survives a read in a separate transaction. Do not change the quota reservation shape of any existing operation.

A10. API surface. GET /v1/runners requires the owner role: assert 401 unauthenticated, 403 for the runner role, 200 for the owner. Add the path and response schema plus the runner_version request object to contracts/openapi/openapi-v1.yaml with additionalProperties:false and every field in required, and assert every existing openapi-conformance assertion in internal/contracts and internal/release still passes. Assert an unknown field inside runner_version is a 400 (DisallowUnknownFields at internal/api/api.go:781 plus additionalProperties:false) and that the response contains no field this Work Order did not name and no synthetic or placeholder value.

A11. Idempotency consequence, asserted not assumed. Assert that replaying one heartbeat request_id with an identical runner_version restores the prior response, and that replaying it with a different runner_version returns the idempotency conflict error, recording the status code. Assert that the conflict path stores nothing new. State in the evidence that this follows from requestFingerprint("heartbeat", req) at internal/application/service.go:393 covering the whole request and is existing semantics rather than new behaviour.

A12. Shape declarations are pinned without an import. internal/application must not import internal/update in production or test code; assert by import scan over internal/application's own *.go files, failing outright on a zero-file scan. Pin the semver shape with a literal accept/reject table in internal/application asserting the same verdicts internal/update/update.go:23 gives for every entry, and pin the 64-hex digest shape the same way. Record in the evidence that the two declarations can drift and that this table is the only thing that will catch it.

A13. Owner console. Append one self-contained block to internal/web/owner.html and one to internal/web/owner.js, each introduced by a comment naming V2-069, at the end of the file, changing no existing byte. The block must let a reader see without parsing which Runners have not reported and whether the intersection is unknown; do not render raw JSON for this section only to satisfy the item. Add no external asset, script or font -- internal/web is embedded and must stay self-contained. Assert the rendered markup contains no credential-shaped and no email-shaped value.

A14. Documentation. Create docs/operations/runner-version-report.md describing: which two of section 5.1's five coordinate groups are reported and why the other three are not, naming their owners; why the carrier is heartbeat rather than enrollment, stating the measured reason that a version captured at enrollment is permanently stale after the first switch; the three report states and what stale means; that the report is never authority over what a Runner may read, and the two checks that prove it; that the intersection is reported and gates nothing because no canonical schema counter exists; and that no Runner in this repository posts a heartbeat today, so the production report count is zero. Do not edit docs/operations/self-update.md or any other document.

A15. Determinism is acceptance. No fixed sleep, no wall-clock timer and no goroutine in any new test; every wait is a bounded deadline poll over an injected clock and every timestamp comes from an injected clock. Run devbox run --pure -- go test -count=1 ./internal/application ./internal/api three times in sequence and record that the verdict line and the output are identical each time, and run it once with -race.

A16. Measured notes for V2-045, recorded and not acted on. Record that this task creates no new import edge -- internal/application imports neither internal/update nor internal/scheduler, and api, store-memory and store-firestore already declare application as a dependency -- and that it moves the application, api, store-memory, store-firestore, web, contracts and docs component keys. Record that editing contracts/openapi/openapi-v1.yaml moves the contracts key, a declared contract dependency of the api and control-plane components. Only the application and api evidence records are issued here; name V2-045 as the owner of the remaining key movement under gate rule G6. V2-045 has landed, so internal/ci's manifest check will fail make check if the declared dependencies and the real import graph diverge: if make check goes red on a manifest or dependency-coverage check, stop and escalate to the tech_lead and do not edit ci/components.json, Makefile, go.mod, go.sum or devbox.* to make it green.

A17. Evidence. Create .agents/v2/evidence/V2-069-application.json (id ev-v2-069-application, task_id V2-069, component application, correlation_id v2-069-runner-version-report) and .agents/v2/evidence/V2-069-api.json (id ev-v2-069-api, task_id V2-069, component api, same correlation_id), recording for every check the argv actually executed, the working directory, the timeout and a summary stating the measured result, with every acceptance item above traceable to a named check. Record the execution environment identifier (uname -srm, go version, devbox environment). A skipped test is recorded with status skipped and never counted as a pass (gate rule G7). Register both with exactly two appended entries in .agents/v2/evidence/index.json whose evidence_hash is the sha256 of each artifact's final committed bytes; touch no other task's entry. devbox run --pure -- go test -count=1 ./internal/contracts must be green with the records in place. Any digest written in prose must match the .gitleaks.toml allowlist shape (64 or 40 hex characters, at most one trailing punctuation character).

A18. Component evidence keys. The evidence_key recorded in each artifact is that component's key read with devbox run --pure -- make evidence-keys on the final tree where make check is green, with every touched file already git-added: a new file that is not yet in the index is invisible to the git ls-files based input set that key is derived from.

A19. devbox run --pure -- make check is green, and it is re-run after the evidence commit so the secret scan reads committed history rather than an uncommitted tree. Record both runs and judge them by the verdict line, not by the shell exit status. No file outside allowed_paths changes.
constraints: Work only inside the assigned isolated task worktree; never push.
Never use git reset, git checkout --, git stash or git commit --amend.
Do not touch internal/domain. No Runner aggregate is created and no field is added to domain.RunnerObservation; assert by git diff that no file under internal/domain changes.

Do not import internal/update from internal/application, in production or in test code. The semver and digest shapes are re-declared as literals and pinned by a table; an import would create an application-to-update edge that only V2-045 may declare.
Do not treat the report as authority over what a Runner may read. No authentication, authorization or admission path may consult it, and no request may be refused because of a reported version.

Do not introduce a canonical schema counter, a canonical schema advance, or any gate on the computed intersection. The intersection is reported; refusing an advance belongs to the task that owns the advance.

Do not add a report field for contract_release, contract_digest, runner_api_min, runner_api_max, bundle_digest, candidate_id, key_id or algorithm, not even as an empty or optional placeholder. No code in the repository produces those values.
Do not accept a Runner-supplied timestamp. reported_at comes from the transaction authority time, and the request object carries no timestamp field.
Do not create a new endpoint for reporting. The report rides on the existing POST /v1/runner/heartbeat as one additive optional object.

Do not touch ci/components.json, Makefile, go.mod, go.sum or devbox.*. V2-045 has landed and internal/ci's manifest check will turn make check red if the declared component dependencies and the real import graph diverge; if that happens, stop and escalate to the tech_lead rather than editing any of those files.
Do not edit contracts/release-contract/** and do not weaken any capability declaration there.
Do not edit .agents/v2/task-state/**, any .agents/v2/packets/** file, or .agents/v2/provider-preflight/**.
Do not edit docs/operations/self-update.md; V2-034 and V2-035 own it and a concurrent edit produces a conflict whose resolution is worse than a new document.

Do not start a real Provider CLI and do not touch any Google Cloud resource. The Firestore assertions run through the local emulator path scripts/firestore-emulator.sh already provides for make component-store-firestore.

Determinism is acceptance, not preference: no fixed sleep, no wall-clock timer, no goroutine in any new test. Waiting is bounded deadline polling over an injected clock, and a measured duration is logged as an observation, never asserted as a threshold.
A skipped test is never counted as a pass (gate rule G7). Record every skip with status skipped and its reason, and record the execution environment identifier.
Never write a verification as passed that was not actually executed. If an acceptance item cannot be satisfied, stop and escalate to the tech_lead rather than fabricating or weakening it.
Every pre-existing test must keep passing under its existing name with its existing assertions unchanged. Report before and after top-level test counts per touched package.
Both owner console files are effectively single-line minified documents: append a self-contained block introduced by a comment naming V2-069 at the end of each, and change no existing byte.
Do not claim in any record that a production Runner reports its version. No heartbeat client exists in this repository; the production report count at completion is zero and must be stated as such.
